entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: First of all then, I am urging that supplications, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be offered regularly for all men;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: for kings and all who are in authority, in order that we may lead a tranquil and peaceful life in all godliness an gravity.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: For this is good and pleasing in the eyes of our Saviour God,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: whose will it is that all men should be saved, and come into full knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For God is one; and one is mediator between God and man, the Man Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave himself as a ransom in behalf of all, to be attested in due time.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: It was for this testimony that I myself was appointed a herald and apostle (I am telling the truth, I am not lying), to be a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: My wish, then, is that in every place the men should offer prayer, lifting up holy hands, free from anger and disputation;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: in like manner also the women. I desire women to clothe themselves in suitable apparel, adorning themselves with reverence and self- restraint; not with hair plaited with gold or pearls, or with expensive clothes,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but (as becomes women proclaiming godliness) with the ornament of good deeds.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let a woman learn quietly in entire submission.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: I allow no woman to teach, or to exercise authority over a man; but let her keep quiet.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: It was Adam who was first formed, then Eve.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: And it was not Adam who was deceived; but it was the woman who was thoroughly deceived, and who became involved in transgression.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: Notwithstanding she will be saved by the Child-bearing; (so will they all), if they live in faith and love and holiness, with self- restraint.
